name: Dependency Repair
description: Read the package manager and lockfile, repair the broken dependency without a broad upgrade, and verify install plus a check.

permissionsRequired.reason: Find every manifest the package manager uses.
Install with the repo's package manager and report the output.
Change only the dependency that is failing.
Run tests after the install when a test script exists.
Typecheck after the install when a tsconfig exists.

validation.rule: The package manager and lockfile were read, only the broken dependency changed, and the install, build, or test output was reported.
